environment: This is Node.js ESM code with no external packages. Predict before running it; we can run it after your answer.

cases.surface: single async call with an outer synchronous log
cases.question: Predict the exact output order. Which part of task runs during the call, and which part waits? Give the reason for that boundary.

criteria.description: Predicts inside-start, outside, inside-end in that order.
Explains that task runs synchronously to its first await and the continuation runs later.

wrongModels.claim: Calling an async function queues its whole body.
Await blocks the caller until the async body finishes.

cases.surface: nested async calls with separate suspension points
cases.question: Predict the exact output order. Identify where inner and outer each suspend, and why top-end can print before either continuation finishes.

criteria.description: Predicts outer-start, inner-start, outer-middle, top-end, inner-end, outer-end in that order.
Explains that both calls begin synchronously, inner suspends at its await, and outer suspends when awaiting inner's promise.

wrongModels.claim: Calling outer queues its entire body behind top-level code.
Awaiting the inner promise blocks the top-level caller.

cases.surface: independent form validations publishing to one displayed state
cases.question: The user changed a field from old to new. Predict the two logged updates and the final displayed value. Explain what the awaits do and do not order here.

criteria.description: Predicts new: new-valid, old: old-invalid, final: old-invalid in that order.
Explains that each validate call resumes after its own load settles; await does not grant the newer field exclusive permission to publish.

wrongModels.claim: Await keeps the latest user choice visible automatically.
Requests must finish in start order.
